scope: F013 near-cancel fields consumed by F014/NP05 and R018
root_cause: The engine classifies a cancellation as near using source_price. Shenzhen V4 CANCEL rows retain the correct side/order ID but source_price is zero, so every buy cancellation fails the buy-side near test while sell cancellations mechanically pass the sell-side test.

impact.reason: NP01-NP04 do not consume near_cancel_buy or near_cancel_sell.

required_remediation: Recover Shenzhen cancellation price point-in-time from the same-side active order state keyed by (date, side, order_id), including auction-origin orders, add Shanghai/Shenzhen cancellation traces and serial/parallel equality tests, issue a new preflight receipt and append-only F013/F014/R018 run IDs.
decision: Do not interpret or promote the existing R018 statistics.
